item.description:
The built-in updater now prepares Leonardo Sync before replacing the Mac application. It waits for a cooperative service stop, keeps existing consent for the next launch, and postpones installation if a safe stop cannot be confirmed. Downloading alone does not pause sharing. Cancelling the application quit resumes the service; an explicit decision to disable it remains respected. Newer registered services are protected against downgrade.
Spanish and English help explains the updated installation behavior and recovery limits. This beta retains the unified project library with origin icons, project removal and restoration, on-demand document downloads and separate offline storage controls.
Known limits: the originating application must already include the preparation logic for it to protect a later update. This beta does not retroactively recover an older service that has already become unreachable after bundle replacement, and external installers do not run the built-in preparation. Automatic renewal across two signed installations and existing paired-iPhone access remain unvalidated. This download supports Apple silicon; Little Leonardo distribution is managed separately through TestFlight.

## Clearer file selection and readable Leonardo filenames
The active file stays highlighted in the project explorer, including MDLF, MDLR and MDLZ, even when automatic following is turned off. Selection uses the system highlight with readable text and icons.
Leonardo filenames retain their wine color in light appearance and use a brighter tint in dark appearance. The English and Spanish guides explain selection and automatic following separately; existing personal guide copies remain intact.
This beta is for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Candidate-specific installed update and relaunch acceptance remains pending.
